saw_lines: Shop owners restock by release and by series, so one new title can pull in a whole order.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, before a shop owner decides your range is worth a click.
Your 18 of 19 copy ads open on the same hai un negozio line, so run three new openers built on 24 hour delivery, a restock and a new release alert.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: 18 of 19 copy ads open on the same “hai un negozio e cerchi” line, so no other angle gets tested. Run three new openers: 24 hour delivery across Italy, a restock before the weekend, and a new release alert.
The same copy runs in 18 of 19 copy ads, so a reader who sees one ad gets the same pitch again. Keep the body, change the opening line and creative in each, starting with three new versions now.

None of your 22 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
None of the 19 copy ads carries an offer, so a first time shop buyer has no reason to order today. Put a first order offer or a bundle of two titles in line one of three new ads.
